title: 第21章 天武炼心第22章 合同
content_zh:
看到这番话，在场众多学生都吓了一跳，以为白真真成功了。
却听李雪莲叹息一声，看向白真真说道“能以一人之力，短短时间内学会这九门武功的招式，你的天赋资质已是万中无一。”
“只可惜距离家父的要求，终究还是差上了一些。”
听到这番话，在场的众多学生有人松了一口气，也有人暗暗吃惊。
赵天行心道“这都没达到要求？这星火真人到底想要个多厉害的徒弟？”
另一边的白真真则是心中暗暗松了一口气。
她刚刚也没想到一举便引动了演武图的变化，还以为此事成了，差点心里一急，就想要开口拒绝掉星火真人收徒的事情。
白真真心中暗道“还好没说出来，不然丢脸丢大了。我就说好像还差了点什么的。”
而在白真真这番动作后，也有人上前尝试着将那九套武功分别演练一番，却再也没有引动天人演武图的变化。
反倒是一直都信心膨胀的炼天极，却是迟迟没有再次上去尝试，似乎在思索着白真真失败的原因，他们到底还差了什么东西。
一时间，整个现场安静了下来，不知不觉已经没有人再上前尝试了。
就在李雪莲感叹到此为止的时候，却见张羽拿着手机走了上去。
“嗯？”李雪莲一下子感兴趣起来，心道“见了这么多人的失败，他还有信心上去，看来是有什么把握了。”
但下一刻，她忍不住皱起了眉头。
因为张羽竟然开始播放手机视频，照着视频中白真真的样子来演练武学。
显然他刚刚把白真真演练武学的样子都拍下来了。
而看到张羽照着视频，一招一式打出来的样子，李雪莲的眉头忍不住皱得更深了。
显然张羽除了自己参悟的拳法之外，对另外八套武功都较为生疏，此刻虽然照着视频中白真真的动作依样画葫芦，却更展现出两人各自对这八套武功招式理解上的差距。
远处的赵天行看着张羽穿着保安服，在众人注视下邯郸学步般模仿着白真真的动作，只觉得头皮发麻，脚趾头都要抠出三室一厅来。
光是这么看着，他就感觉众人看向张羽的目光里好似充满了轻蔑和嘲笑，他难以想象真正站在那个位置，做着这件事情的本人会是什么感觉。

“快停下啊张羽！”赵天行不忍再看，只在心中大喊道“太丢人了，你已经被当成小丑了！”
张羽自然不可能听到赵天行的想法，也不在意画展场地里的这些人现在怎么看他。
他只是认认真真，照着视频里白真真的动作一招一式将九门武学一一演练了一番。
而随着他最后一招打完，无数的经验、感觉骤然涌入了他的脑海之中，让张羽瞬间对天人演武图有了不同的理解，就好像是打了几万遍一样。
这一刻，九门武功的招式在他的脑海中逐渐消失，取而代之的是九种不同的意念在他的脑海中若隐若现。
这一刻的张羽陡然明白了过来，天人演武图上的九门武功重的是意念，而非招式。
修炼者要做的是在修炼武功的同时，在那一招一式中，揣摩其意境。
击破万军的杀意、九死不悔的斗志、一往无前的气魄……九门武功，培养的是武道意念，以此来坚固自己的道心。
“这不是一门战斗或者炼体的武学，而是一门以武道意念来淬炼道心的武学。”
这是一门用来提升道心等级的武道心法！
武道意念，是十大宗门经过梳理之后，对剑意、拳意、刀意等等武道力量的统称。
武道意念最基本的作用，是可以强壮精神，坚固自身的意志，以此提升修行者的道心等级。
而像星火真人这样的金丹真人，其武道意念甚至能留在画中，影响他人的精神意识。
与此同时，张羽身上的气质也随着产生了一种强烈的变化。
杀意、斗志、气魄、勇武……一股股无比强悍的气质从他体内浮现出来，似乎就要在这一刻一口气凝练为他的武道意念。
与此同时，天人演武图上的男子也变得越来越清晰，甚至渐渐出现了鲜艳的色彩，如同是变成了一个真正的人一般，紧紧盯着张羽身上的变化。
发现这一点的在场众人也惊了，这绝对是今天天人演武图反应最大的一次。
炼天极、钱深、白真真……全都紧紧盯着张羽，他们也全都感觉到了张羽身上的变化，脑海中升起同一个不可思议的想法。
“他真要成了？”
可就在下一刻，张羽身上的变化陡然间被彻底打断，刚刚好像还要凝聚出来的武道意念也在这一刻消散一空。

“可惜可惜。”画上浮现出一句话来“天纵之资，棋差一招。”
张羽的脸上却没有什么意外之色。
天武炼心诀0级（11，838法力，08508**强度，13级道心）
只见羽书之上浮现着一门唤作天武炼心诀的武功。
content_en:
Seeing these words, many students present were shocked, thinking that Bai Zhenzhen had succeeded.
But Li Xuelian sighed, looked at Bai Zhenzhen and said, "You can learn the moves of these nine martial arts in a short period of time with the strength of one person. Your talent and qualifications are unique among ten thousand."
"It's a pity that it's still a little behind my father's requirements."
Hearing these words, some of the many students present breathed a sigh of relief, while others were secretly surprised.
Zhao Tianxing thought to himself, "This doesn't meet the requirements? How powerful a disciple does Master Xinghuo want?"
Bai Zhenzhen on the other side was secretly relieved.
She didn't expect that one move would trigger changes in the martial arts diagram just now. She thought it was done, and she almost became anxious and wanted to refuse Master Xinghuo's appointment as a disciple.
Bai Zhenzhen thought to himself, "It's a good thing I didn't say it out loud, otherwise it would have been a big embarrassment. I just said it seemed like something was missing."
After Bai Zhenzhen's actions, some people came forward and tried to practice the nine sets of martial arts separately, but they never caused any changes in the martial arts diagram of heaven and man.
On the contrary, Lian Tianji, who had always been confident, had not yet tried again. He seemed to be thinking about the reason for Bai Zhenzhen's failure and what else they were missing.
For a moment, the entire scene fell silent, and before anyone knew it, no one came forward to try again.
Just when Li Xuelian sighed that it was over, she saw Zhang Yu walking up with a mobile phone.
"Huh?" Li Xuelian suddenly became interested and thought to herself, "After seeing so many people's failures, he still has the confidence to go up. It seems that he has some confidence."
But the next moment, she couldn't help but frown.
Because Zhang Yu actually started playing the video on his mobile phone, practicing martial arts just like Bai Zhenzhen in the video.
Apparently he had just taken pictures of Bai Zhenzhen practicing martial arts.
And seeing Zhang Yu following the video and executing each move, Li Xuelian couldn't help but frown deeper.
Obviously Zhang Yu is relatively unfamiliar with the other eight sets of martial arts apart from the boxing techniques he has learned. At this moment, although he is following Bai Zhenzhen's movements in the video, it further shows the gap between the two in their understanding of these eight sets of martial arts moves.
From a distance, Zhao Tianxing saw Zhang Yu wearing security uniform, Handan imitating Bai Zhenzhen's movements like a toddler under the gaze of everyone. He felt his scalp numb and his toes digging out of the three rooms and one living room.
Just looking at it like this, he felt that the eyes of everyone looking at Zhang Yu seemed to be full of contempt and ridicule. He could not imagine what it would be like to actually stand in that position and do this thing.
"Stop it, Zhang Yu!" Zhao Tianxing couldn't bear to look any further and just shouted in his heart, "It's so embarrassing, you have been treated as a clown!"
Zhang Yu naturally couldn't hear Zhao Tianxing's thoughts, and he didn't care what the people in the exhibition venue thought of him now.
He just took it seriously and practiced the nine martial arts one by one according to Bai Zhenzhen's movements in the video.
And as he finished his last move, countless experiences and feelings suddenly poured into his mind, allowing Zhang Yu to instantly have a different understanding of the martial arts diagram of heaven and man, as if he had fought it tens of thousands of times.
At this moment, the nine martial arts moves gradually disappeared in his mind, replaced by nine different ideas looming in his mind.
At this moment, Zhang Yu suddenly understood that the nine martial arts in the Tianren Martial Arts Map focused on thoughts rather than moves.
What practitioners have to do is to figure out the artistic conception of each move while practicing martial arts.
The murderous intention to defeat thousands of armies, the fighting spirit to survive even one death, and the courage to move forward... The nine martial arts cultivate the martial arts thoughts to strengthen one's Taoist heart.
"This is not a martial arts for fighting or body training, but a martial arts that uses martial arts thoughts to temper the Taoist heart."
This is a martial arts heart used to improve the level of the heart.Law!
Martial arts intention is the collective name for the martial arts powers such as sword intention, fist intention, knife intention, etc. after being sorted out by the ten major sects.
The most basic function of martial arts thoughts is to strengthen the spirit and strengthen one's own will, thereby improving the practitioner's level of Taoism.
As for Jindan Zhenren like Xinghuo Zhenren, his martial arts ideas can even stay in the painting and affect the spiritual consciousness of others.
At the same time, Zhang Yu's temperament also underwent a strong change.
Killing intent, fighting spirit, courage, bravery... streams of extremely powerful temperament emerged from his body, and seemed to be condensed into his martial arts thoughts at this moment.
At the same time, the man on the picture of Tianren Martial Arts became more and more clear, and even bright colors gradually appeared, as if he had turned into a real person, staring closely at the changes in Zhang Yu's body.
Everyone present was shocked when they discovered this. This was definitely the biggest reaction to Tianren's martial arts performance today.
Lian Tianji, Qian Shen, Bai Zhenzhen... all stared at Zhang Yu closely. They all felt the changes in Zhang Yu, and the same incredible thought arose in their minds.
"Is he really going to do it?"
But at the next moment, the changes in Zhang Yu's body were suddenly completely interrupted, and the martial arts thoughts that seemed to be condensed just now also dissipated at this moment.
"It's a pity." A sentence appeared on the painting, "He is gifted only by one move."
There was no surprise on Zhang Yu's face.
Tianwu Lianxin Jue level 0 (11,838 mana, 08508** strength, level 13 Taoist heart)
I saw a martial art called Tianwu Heart Refining Technique floating on the feather book.
